sentences.en: This is an arrangement recommended by one who has tried it, and he reassures the old-fashioned believer who clings to the less formal regime (and whose protest was voiced in the Montanist movement), that there will be no spiritual loss under the new system.

sentences.en: What the philosophy of the Jenny Craig Diet emphasizes is moderation versus deprivation, it also reassures them all foods can fit into a nutritious eating plan.

sentences.en: In fact, the American Diabetes Association (ADA) reassures patients that a healthy diet plan for diabetics is nearly identical to nutritional recommendations for everyone else.
